notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3 - User Experience Improvement
notes.content:
- Added swapping cooldown indicator on the swapping device
- Changed the headbob of the player to be feel more natural
- Added the ability to toggle cheats (Settings -> Cheats)
- Adjusted environment lighting

notes.title: Patch 1.2 (Lobby improvement!)
notes.content:
Patch notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players could not join lobby
[*] Fixed a bug where players could not start tutorial after creating a lobby
[*] Fixed a bug where players cannot finish
[*] Fixed a bug where the audio of the pickups would keep playing after picking them up
[*] Fixed a bug where the audio volume of some pickups would not be influenced by the audio settings
[*] Added audio save button feedback
[*] Changed codelock task code refresh from 60 seconds to 10 seconds
[*] Changed the interval of the footsteps to be more natural
[*] Changed death SFX
[*] Adjusted monsters' visuals
[/list]

notes.title: Day One patch
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for playing our game and you patience! This patch improves the visuals by a lot and makes the game flow way better, we hope you enjoy it :)

[list]
[*]Added player models and animations
[*]Added enemy animations
[*]Added sound sliders
[*]Improved audio
[*]Improved lighting
[*]Improved playability
[*]Improved UI
[*]Improved task flow
[*]Fixed networking issues (hopefully :))
[/list]
